public_projection_notice: Chronological internal AI-agent/code audit, not outside peer review. Private paths redacted; original artifact hash retained in ORIGINAL_EVIDENCE_INDEX.json. Historic paths refer to private research archive, not necessarily public-repository files.

results.scope: Static source audit plus synthetic implementation checks; v1 six45-word files prepared, not a negative optimizer campaign; v2 pending separate root qualification.

findings.mechanism: while(cf>>v) stops on noninteger extraction failure without checking eof; a valid prefix is silently treated as the complete input and later tokens ignored.
findings.actual_input_effect: No corruption if preregistered actual input is independently proven entirely integer0..26 with expected full slot count. Must reject malformed input or independently enforce full parsing before actual attack.

findings.mechanism: Output stream open/write success is not checked. The scorer may exit successfully despite inaccessible output destination. Downstream missing-file/hash validation would detect this.
findings.actual_input_effect: Not a score or cipher-model defect.

limits: No target optimization or v1/v2 controls inference was run by this reviewer. The tiny artificial arithmetic/roundtrip smoke check does not qualify optimizer recovery.
V1 prepared45-word controls are not a failed experiment; target-matched v2 qualification is separate.
26-letter key is injective on22 observed cipher classes; unused key entries are unidentifiable from target and cannot be counted as recovered evidence.
ASCII accent-stripped Czech is an explicit language/orthography hypothesis; 1990s/news/business UD text is not1952 exercise-domain proof.
Quadgram score is a fixed heuristic, not posterior odds or evidence that target is Czech.
Source normalization maps combining accents away and excludes non-ASCII tokens; restored accents must be marked inferred.
Binaryfloat storage is host-native; current reconstruction byte-exact on this little-endian host, not universal architecture portability.
